messages.content:
It looks like the Collection No. values for Telepatic Psychic Energy and Rock Fighting Energy are reversed. This is what is currently shown in the file:

19 Telepath Psychic Energy POR 87 20 Rock Fighting Energy POR 88

This was fixed in Card_ID List_EN.pdf

19 Telepath Psychic Energy POR 88 View Image 20 Rock Fighting Energy POR 87 View Image

The id numbers are consistent, but this will affect competitors looking to import their own decks using the Expansion and Collection No.
